subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Shared: uses the cover to predict; identifies the sequence of events; recognises cause and effect; interprets posters; answers open-ended questions

show.line: Stories happen in order. First, next, last. First the egg cracks. Next the chick comes out. Last it runs!

rounds.story: Nandi plants a seed. She waters it. A flower grows! What happened first?
Nandi plants a seed. She waters it. A flower grows! What happened last?

rounds.prompt: Look at the cover. What do you think the story is about?
rounds.praise: A dog at the beach! The cover gives clues.

rounds.story: It rained all night. In the morning the field was full of puddles. Why were there puddles?

rounds.prompt: Sam dropped the glass. What happened next? Say it.
Read the poster. What time does the school fun run start?
rounds.praise: Nine o'clock! The poster tells us.

hints: Think about what comes first, next and last.
Why did it happen? Look for the cause.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! The seed story. First, next, last.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: First the flower grows. Then she plants the seed!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! You plant the seed first. The flower grows last.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it in order. Plant, water, grow!

parent_line: Can put story events in order and say why something happened.
